title: P1-05 — Final Phase 1 acceptance and merge readiness
objective: P1-05 final acceptance/merge readiness. Successor to #49/#51; depends on completion of P1-01 #53, P1-02 #54, P1-03 #55, and P1-04 #56. No merge absent explicit owner approval. Operating policy: docs/workflows/phase1-continuous-execution.md, including the owner-approved M1→M2→M3 priority and continuous-execution correction: a runtime gate blocks only dependent operations; continue independent authorized work. Handoffs identify the exact blocked assumption, independent work completed/remaining, and action to unlock it. No acceptance criterion changes.

acceptance_criteria.text: Record final integrated source SHA, ticket-evidence SHA and repository HEAD distinctly; preserve candidate a43e9aaa746af22dbd0ab106b5d12fc33b7fb982 smoke/cleanup/CI as historical evidence only.
All relevant automated tests and owner CI pass on the final integrated SHA; every changed VM runtime/provisioning SHA receives a new owner-run protected full smoke.
Owner demonstrates interactive TUI/model selection, exit-confirm behavior, accurate host metrics, and approved terminal configuration on a distinct interactive Dev VM and private bounded workspace.
Controlled negative tests cover forbidden filesystem, host-loopback/LAN, terminal control, credential persistence and abnormal termination without probing real private services or sensitive data.
Independent cleanup verification is designed for the interactive-session binding, proves identity-bound QEMU/proxy/virtiofsd teardown, and does not rely on PID-file contents.
Sol combined review covers exact final source SHA; Claude performs final adversarial assessment; owner explicitly approves merge. No tool performs an automated merge.
